source.description: A weekly Bitcoin show about saving, custody and the products built around them. In this episode we go through the week's price action, the on-chain data we watch, and your questions from the comments. Chapters: 00:00 Intro 01:12 Price action 06:40 On-chain 11:05 Your questions 18:30 Wrap-up. If you enjoy the show, subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss an episode, and share it with a friend who is just getting started.
